关键词: Results of Operations and Financial Condition
主要内容: Waters Corporation, a U.S.-based company, announced its results of operations for the quarter and year ended December 31, 2014, on January 26, 2015. The company provided a press release detailing its financial performance for the period, which is attached as Exhibit 99.1 to the Form 8-K filing. The press release is incorporated by reference into the report. The filing includes the signature of Eugene G. Cassis, Corporate Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, confirming the report's authenticity. This report is filed under Section 13 or 15(d) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934.
